note: execution: 'coinbase' = Coinbase Exchange (real orders via broker_coinbase.py when an API key is present, shadow ledger on the same public data when it is not) | 'ledger' = shadow only | 'alpaca' = Alpaca paper. Live orders also require live_ack: true, min_grade_before_live graded outcomes, and a cycle heartbeat younger than max_gap_h. Per-trade live risk = min(sizer, live_max_risk, equity*live_max_risk_frac); if the notional that needs exceeds max_notional_frac of equity the trade is SKIPPED, never quietly trimmed. See README 'Going live'.
